target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test current, adjacent/emerging and overlooked material against its strongest plausible lawful placement. Character changes and hard left turns may pass when transition, local-run and long-form intent are supported; selection-lens interest alone is insufficient.

sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASES: https://sublunarrecords.bandcamp.com/album/kept-what-remained — all nine tracks from Hadone's 2026-08-21 album screened; The Enemy Within retained because Sublunar's exact-track notes describe intricate sound design joined to powerful rhythmic structures.

ADJACENT / EMERGING: https://sublunarrecords.bandcamp.com/album/one-touch — all six tracks from Clotur's 2026-06-19 release screened; Drummz retained because the exact-track notes describe dynamic, unpredictable rhythms, refined groove work and a strong sense of movement.

ADJACENT / EMERGING: https://sunpeople.bandcamp.com/album/endophyte-ep and https://firstfloor.substack.com/p/sun-people-x-other-worlds-endophyte — all four tracks from the 2026-03-06 Sun People x Other Worlds EP screened; Psychicemotus retained because the exact-track review describes a chunky gallop and the release is explicitly framed as left-field techno crossing footwork, jungle and techno.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: https://sublunarrecords.bandcamp.com/album/void-century-w-patrick-russell-remix — all four tracks from Donor's 2018-09-21 release screened; Forgotten retained because Sublunar's exact-track notes describe glitches, twists, broken beats and a curious polyrhythmic gait.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: all six tracks from Vilchezz — Deadlock, all eight tracks from Sciama — Collapse of Order, all twelve tracks from Scibor — Searching for Colors, and four OODE1 catalogue clips were screened alongside bounded 2026 techno/broken-rhythm result pages.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 53 named tracks across eight current, adjacent and catalogue releases plus bounded result pages; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 13 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Run 53's Outer Orbit, Soma and Seismic leads were not retried.
The two protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

Other Hadone, Clotur, Sun People x Other Worlds, Donor, Vilchezz, Sciama and Scibor tracks were screened but ranked below the four leads for exact-track structural evidence relevant to this run; no artist, label, texture or novelty quota was used.

No lead was promoted for recency, artist reputation, genre, title, novelty, supplied Spotify identity or assumed BPM. Energy, density, bodily effect, phrase structure, perceived pulse, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Clotur — Drummz: current exact-track label notes describe dynamic and unpredictable rhythms, refined groove work and strong movement; supplied Spotify ID requires resolver verification.
2. Donor — Forgotten: overlooked exact-track label notes describe glitches, twists, broken beats and a curious polyrhythmic gait; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.

3. Sun People, Other Worlds — Psychicemotus: current independent exact-track review describes a chunky gallop within a left-field techno collaboration; supplied Spotify ID requires resolver verification.
4. Hadone — The Enemy Within: current exact-track label notes describe intricate sound design and powerful rhythmic structures; supplied Spotify ID requires resolver verification.
